query: UPDATE password_write_intents intent SET record=CASE WHEN item.deleting THEN jsonb_build_object('metadata',item.metadata,'user_id',item.user_id,'grants',item.grants,'deleting',true,'revision',item.revision,'totp_key_id',NULL) ELSE intent.record || jsonb_build_object('user_id',item.user_id,'grants',item.grants) END FROM password_item_entities item WHERE intent.team_id=$1 AND intent.team_id=item.team_id AND intent.item_id=item.id AND intent.record->>'user_id'=$2
